Only the finishing touches remain... But it's proving difficult.
strings.아저씨, 너무 무리하지 마세요. 저번 일은 어머니께서 고맙다고 전해달라: Don't push yourself too hard. Mother asked me to thank you for what you did last time.
strings.아니다. 내가 더 고맙지. 아이들을 가르치게 해주셔서 감사하다고 시스터께: No, I'm the grateful one. Tell Sister I appreciate her letting me teach the children.
strings.네! 테오 아저씨는 언제나 환영이에요. 아, %s. 언제 왔어요?: I will! You're always welcome, Uncle Theo. Oh, %s! When did you get here?
Just now. Hello, Theo. Hello, Narsha.
I have something to finish, so I'll leave you to talk.
strings.%s, 자네가 에스닐에 온 걸 보니 지스크 영지의 일이 잘 끝난 것 같군: %s, seeing you here in Esnil tells me things went well in the Zisk Territory. I'm glad.
Yes, more or less. I'm just not sure how much I should tell you.
strings.괜찮네. 지스카드 경께서 따로 편지를 주시기로 했으니까 크게 신경 안써도: It's all right. Lord Ziskad has promised to write to me, so don't worry about it.
strings.아직 그 일이 뭔지 모르겠지만, 확실히 큰일이란 건 알겠네. 그거 때문에: I don't yet know what happened, but I can tell it was something significant. There's one thing that worries me.
strings.제국에서 자네를 주목하고 있는 건 알고 있겠지?: You know the Empire is watching you, don't you?
Yes. I've found myself involved in its affairs.
I'm sure you're managing perfectly well without my advice, but please be careful.
strings.궁금한 게 하나 있는데, 듣기로 자네가 신비한 소수민족과 친분이 있다고: There's something I'm curious about. I hear you're acquainted with a mysterious minority people. Have you ever met anyone who looks like Narsha?
strings.나르샤가 예전에 자네와 대화하다 궁금한게 생겼다며 묻더군. 그 아이의 영: Narsha asked me about something she'd been wondering since she spoke with you. I imagine it will always be a question for her...
strings.하지만, 나도 아는 게 없으니 쉽게 답해줄 수는 없었네. 나중에 자네가: But I don't know anything either, so I couldn't give her an answer. I'd appreciate it if you could tell her what you know sometime.
I don't have anywhere in particular to go. Since you're asking...
strings.그래. 마법학원에 있는 시이나 황녀께서 …. 아니, 시이나가 자네를 찾더: Yes. Princess Shiina at the magic academy... I mean, Shiina was looking for you.
You don't have to hide it anymore.
strings.그래도 아는 사람들끼리는 이런 식으로 해야 재미있지 않겠나? 데이나 녀석: Still, isn't it more fun for those of us who know to keep up the act? Dayna really did a clumsy job of revealing her identity.
Oh, after what happened in Moros...
I had a good laugh when I heard. Hehe.
strings.테오, 그러다 황실 모욕죄로 잡혀 가는 거 아닌가요?: Theo, won't you get arrested for insulting the imperial family?
Haha, we can't have that. Off you go to the magic academy.
All right, Theo. See you later.
strings.(그런데 시이나가 왜 날 찾은 거지? 궁금하네….): (Why is Shiina looking for me? I wonder...)
strings.(시이나가 %s의 모습을 보자마자 다가가서 안긴다.): (The moment Shiina spots %s, she runs over and gives the adventurer a hug.)
It's been a while. You startled me, running over like that.
I'm sorry. I've gotten into the habit of hugging people lately without thinking.
strings.안 그래도 작은 언니 만나러 갔다가 테오 선생님께 그냥 모험가님이 보고: I visited my middle sister and happened to tell Teacher Theo that I wanted to see you...
strings.큰 언니의 전언이 있었어요. 맘 같아선 언니가 직접 하세요, 라고 말하고: My eldest sister sent a message. I'd like to tell her to deliver it herself, but... I can't quite do that. I can't disobey her orders. Hehe...
strings.언니가 말을 꺼낸 걸 보면 모험가님도 알고 계시겠죠? 어떻게 아시는 지는: If my sister brought it up, you must know about her, right? I won't ask how.
strings.어떤 밤이었어요. 아버지께서 돌아가시기 며칠 전. 어떤 여자가 절 그들에: It happened one night, a few days before my father passed away. A woman took me to them.
strings.그 여자는 다프네였어요. 제가 필요하다면서 어떤 검은 곳으로 데려가려고: That woman was Daphne. She said she needed me and tried to take me into a dark place, but Kaina and Dayna stopped her.
The Moon's Scar knights helped, too.
strings.카이나 언니는 다프네를 알고 있던 것 같았고…. 하여튼, 다프네는 자신을: Kaina seemed to know Daphne... Anyway, Daphne introduced herself as a witch, said she'd find another way, and told us to forget her.
strings.그 말을 듣는 순간, 기사단과 우리 자매 모두 정신을 잃었어요. 다시 깨: The moment she said that, the knights and all three of us lost consciousness. When we woke, everyone had forgotten Daphne, as though they'd agreed to it. But...
Somehow, I think you and your sisters, including Her Majesty, still remember.
strings.황가에는 특별한 능력을 갖춘 아이가 드물게 태어나는데…. 저희 대에선 저: Sometimes a child with special abilities is born into the imperial family... In our generation, all three of us...
My eldest sister, my middle sister, and I... We're all a little unusual.
strings.…언니는 당분간 기억을 잃은 척 행동하라 했어요. 모험가 님이 다프네에: ...My sister told us to pretend we'd lost our memories for the time being. When you asked about Daphne, I think I got flustered and let something slip...
strings.후우…, 좀 길었죠?: Whew... That was a long story, wasn't it?
strings.그래서 하셔야 할 일이 있어요. 다프네와 관련된 한 분의 기억을 깨우셔야: So there's something you must do. You need to awaken the memories of someone connected to Daphne. That's my sister's message.
You seem to have someone in mind.
Yes... I should go right away. I happen to know how to do it...
I should be thanking you. That can't have been easy to talk about.
strings.제가 모험가님을 좋아해서 괜찮아요. 그리고… 마녀를 알고 있는 그분의 기: It's all right, because I like you, Adventurer. And... I hope the memories of that person who knows the witch aren't anything terrible.
strings.(일단 보석나무 숲에서 빛의 눈물을 찾아보자. 찾을 수 있을까….): (First, I'll look for a Tear of Light in the Jewel Tree Forest. I hope I can find one...)
You have been through much in a short time.
strings.(지스크 영지에 다녀온 것도 알고 계신 것 같네….): (She seems to know I visited the Zisk Territory...)
It seems I learn these things whether I wish to or not.
strings.알고 계셨군요. 자, 여기…. 빛의 눈물입니다. 자, 잠깐만요. 이걸 바: You knew. Here... A Tear of Light. W-wait! If you swallow it whole...
strings.(메디아가 받아든 빛의 눈물을 그대로 삼킨다.): (Medea swallows the Tear of Light as soon as she receives it.)
Shynic really is dreadful, forcing you to eat this...
I'm fine. It doesn't taste good.
Lady Daphne must have had something very significant to hide from me.
strings.사람은 기억을 품고 사는 생물…. 그 기억을 바탕으로 삶을 유지하기도 포: Humans live with their memories. Those memories can give them the will to keep living, or cause them to give up.
strings.유지한다면 그 기억은 자신에게 좋은 느낌으로 남게 되겠죠. 비록 자신에게: If they choose to keep living, those memories may remain as something comforting, even if they change to favor the person remembering them.
strings.그렇게 저에게 다프네 님은 좋은 느낌으로 남아있습니다. 하지만, 모험가님: That is how Lady Daphne remains in my mind. But whoever sent you here must feel differently about her.
%s, please find one more thing for me. Very little has come back to me...
It's something you brought me before.
A Seed of Illusion? I'll find one as quickly as I can.
Medea, here's the Seed of Illusion.
strings.(메디아가 환영의 씨앗을 받아 빤히 바라본다.): (Medea takes the Seed of Illusion and stares at it.)
strings.%s. 제가 약을 만드는 동안, 잠시만, 베이넌을 불러주시겠습니까?: %s, while I prepare the medicine, would you fetch Beinan?
strings.베이넌이요? 지금 마을에 있나요?: Beinan? Is he in the village now?
Merimel is here, so he must have returned.
strings.요즘 저 몰래 메리멜을 아드리카 밖으로 데리고 나가더군요. 분명 타르타로: Lately, he's been taking Merimel out of Adrica behind my back. I'm sure he's helping her meet Noel near Tartaros...
Don't be too hard on him. Beinan can protect Merimel.
strings.누가 누구를 지킨다는 말, 결코 쉬운 게 아닙니다. 그 무게를 감당할 수: Saying one person will protect another is never a simple matter. If they cannot bear that responsibility...
I'm sorry. That was uncalled for. In any case, Merimel must become stronger too.
I'll bring Beinan right away, Medea.
strings.(메디아가 환영의 씨앗으로 약을 만들지 않고 바로 삼켜버린다.): (Instead of making medicine, Medea swallows the Seed of Illusion whole.)
strings.(메디아의 귓가에 낯익은 누군가의 목소리가 들려온다.): (A familiar voice sounds in Medea's ears.)
Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea.
Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea!!!
strings.너는 이 기억을 꺼내지 말았어야 했다!!: You should never have uncovered this memory!!
strings.네가, 네가 가진 그 힘이 일족의 희생만으로 이루어졌다고 생각하느냐!!: Do you think your power came only from the sacrifice of your people?!!
strings.(메디아의 머릿속에 어떤 사건의 잔상이 계속해서 떠오르다가 유리조각처럼: (Images of an event surface again and again in Medea's mind, then shatter like glass.)
strings.(주저앉은 메디아가 베이넌의 부축을 받고 일어선다.): (Beinan helps Medea rise from where she has sunk to the ground.)
That relentless, harsh voice... So ominous... Why would you...
strings.잠깐, 환영의 씨앗…. 그것도 한 번에 삼키신 거예요?: Wait, the Seed of Illusion... Did you swallow that whole too?
I-I'm fine. Now I... No. %s, please leave.
%s, I'm sorry, but please do as Lady Medea asks and leave for today.
strings.(베이넌에게서 살기가 느껴져…. 돌아가지 않겠다면 당장이라도 공격할 기센: (I can feel Beinan's killing intent... He looks ready to attack if I refuse to leave...)
strings.부탁입니다. 오늘은 부디 돌아가 주세요. 제가, 제가…. 따로 부르겠습니: Please. I beg you, leave for today. I... I will send for you.
All right. Please rest. I'll come when you call.
strings.(%s의 모습이 칼리에서 사라진 걸 확인한 메디아가 베이넌을 붙잡고 흐느: (Once she is sure %s has left Kali, Medea clings to Beinan and sobs.)
Your memories of that time... You still have them, don't you, Beinan? You must.
The memories from just before you died...
What, what happened back then?! What happened...?
